title: Driver hiring, pre-employment clearance, orientation and initial training (2018 historical workflow)
summary: Historical end-to-end driver intake and training workflow evidenced by the 2018 Driver Training & Orientation Synopsis. It is preserved as a validated description of that source, not assumed to be current practice.

claims.claim: Applications were reviewed by RTEC Administration for completeness, mistakes, prior experience and education before further processing.

Historical pre-employment screening included driving-record checks, criminal/background checks, reference checks, an interview by at least two Administration/Management members, and a pre-offer contingent on DOT physical and pre-employment drug testing.

evidence.page_or_section: RTEC Driver Training; Medical; Background Record

claims.claim: The document required a verified negative DOT drug-test result and qualifying DOT physical before solo safety-sensitive work, with additional background/registry checks completed before safety-sensitive function.

evidence.note: Historical requirement; current regulatory/process status must be revalidated.

claims.claim: Historical driver orientation included a multi-day curriculum followed by approximately 30 hours of OJT with an experienced driver, management review of training documentation, and a three-month introductory evaluation.

evidence.page_or_section: On-The-Job Training; Driver Training Plan; Training Completion

trigger: Receipt and approval of an application for a posted driver opening.
prerequisites: Verified negative pre-employment DOT drug test
actors: Fleet Manager and/or ASE Certified Mechanic
forms: Cabinet for Health & Human Services agreement
Previous Employer Drug & Alcohol Testing Release Form
steps: Review application for completeness, mistakes, experience and education.
Complete driving-record, background and reference checks.
Schedule and conduct interview with at least two Administration/Management members.
If selected, make pre-offer contingent on DOT physical and pre-employment drug test.
Complete required pre-employment paperwork and prior-employer drug/alcohol records request.
Confirm qualifying DOT physical and verified negative drug-test result before safety-sensitive work.
Complete additional registry/background checks described in the source.
Complete orientation and initial driver training curriculum.
Complete OJT with an experienced driver and document performance.
Obtain management/training review before solo vehicle assignment.
Retain training documentation in the employee training file.
Evaluate performance at end of three-month introductory period.
decisions: Whether OJT performance is satisfactory or needs corrective/additional training.
Whether driver is ready for solo assignment.
deadlines: Driver was given two weeks to read and understand distributed handbooks/policies/procedures.
Historical OJT target was approximately/minimum 30 hours, subject to experience and proficiency.
Historical introductory evaluation occurred at three months.

First Aid/CPR recertification described as at least every two years; blood-borne pathogens and fire-extinguisher training described as annual; passenger-assistance refresher recommended at least every two years.
exceptions: OJT could exceed or be reduced below 30 hours depending on experience and proficiency.
Some in-vehicle defensive-driving evaluation could be substituted by OJT/trainer evaluation.
NCI could be temporarily replaced by Managing Threatening Confrontations training.
controls: No solo safety-sensitive function before specified clearance/training requirements.
Supervisor/Operations/Training review gates before vehicle assignment.
unresolved_questions: What current systems/forms replaced the historical paper releases and routing sheet?
Are the cited recertification intervals still current?
What current regulatory checks are required and which are RTEC policy rather than external regulation?
automation_candidates: Driver onboarding checklist with gated prerequisites and evidence attachments.
Routing-sheet replacement that prevents solo assignment until mandatory gates are complete.

provenance.notes: Validated as a faithful model of the historical source; not validated as current policy.
